dimensions.assessment: Directly affects Korean American families divided from family members in North Korea after the Korean War Armistice Agreement.
dimensions.evidence: identify Korean American families who wish to be reunited with family members residing in North Korea

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a private, internal national registry and repository of information to facilitate future reunions and dialogue.
dimensions.evidence: establish a private, internal national registry of the names and other relevant information of such Korean American families

dimensions.assessment: Mentions an authorization of appropriations of $1,000,000 in the legislative history/deleted text section.
dimensions.evidence: There is authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of State $1,000,000 to carry out this section.

dimensions.assessment: Requires the State Department to set up a registry, enter into voluntary information-sharing agreements, conduct consultations, and add reporting elements.
dimensions.evidence: establish a private, internal national registry of the names and other relevant information of such Korean American families

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing reporting requirements and a permanent registry framework.
dimensions.evidence: establish a private, internal national registry

missing_information: The reported version of the bill text struck out the specific $1,000,000 authorization of appropriations found earlier in the document, leaving the exact funding mechanism unstated in the final reported text.
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Secretary of State to establish a national registry for Korean American divided families and authorizes $1,000,000 for carrying out the section in the deleted text version.
